data.name: Khaatim
data.long_meaning: In Islamic history, Khaatim refers to a person who seals or completes a task or era. In the Quran, it is mentioned that Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) is the Khaatim of all prophets. Thus, Khaatim is a name with deep spiritual significance and a reminder of the Prophet's role as the last and final messenger of Allah.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of completion and continuity in the chain of prophets.
data.numerology_meaning: People with the name Khaatim are expressive, creative, and excellent communicators. They have a strong need for self-expression and a deep emotional sensitivity. They are often drawn to the arts, and they have a great capacity for understanding other people's feelings and emotions. They are generous, caring, and compassionate, and they have a strong desire to help others.

in_arabic.name: خاتم
in_arabic.long_meaning: خاتم هو اسم مشتق من الفعل 'ختم' والذي يعني التمام أو النهاية. يعتبر اسم خاتم من الأسماء النبوية، حيث كان الرسول محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم يسمى خاتم الأنبياء لكونه آخر الأنبياء والرسل. يشير الاسم إلى الكمال والتمام، ويعتبر من الأسماء ذات الدلالة العميقة في الإسلام.

in_urdu.name: خاتم
in_urdu.meaning: مہراب ختم کرنے والا، آخرین رسول
in_urdu.long_meaning: خاتم ایک عربی نام ہے جو ختم کرنے کے معنی میں ہے۔ یہ نام رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کی خصوصیت کے لیے استعمال کیا جاتا تھا، کیونکہ وہ آخرین رسول تھے۔ اس نام کا مطلب ہے مکمل کرنے والا یا ختم کرنے والا، جو اسلامی تقليد میں اہم دلالت رکھتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: खातम
in_hindi.long_meaning: खातम एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है समाप्त करने वाला या अंतिम। यह नाम पैगंबर मुहम्मद की विशेषता के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता था, क्योंकि वह अंतिम पैगंबर थे। इस नाम का अर्थ है पूर्ण करने वाला या समाप्त करने वाला, जो इस्लामी परंपरा में गहरा महत्व रखता है।

in_pashto.name: خاتم
in_pashto.long_meaning: خاتم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی چې معنی یې د پای یا انتهاء څرګندول دي. دا نوم د رسول الله صلی الله عليه وسلم خصوصیت لپاره کارول کیده، ځکه هغه د پيغمبرانو وروستی وو. دا نوم داسې معنی لري چې بشپړونکی یا خاتم کوونکی، کوم چې په اسلامي دود کې مهم دلالت لري.

in_english.name: Khaatim
in_english.meaning: The final prophet, seal or culmination
in_english.long_meaning: Khaatim is derived from the Arabic root 'kh-t-m', meaning to seal, conclude, or finalize. In Islamic tradition, it refers to Prophet Muhammad as 'Khatam al-Anbiya' (the seal of the prophets), signifying he was the final messenger sent by Allah. The name embodies the concept of completion, finality, and spiritual culmination, carrying deep significance in Islamic theology and culture.

data.cultural_impact: The title of Khaatim holds a special place in Islamic culture and literature. It is often used as an honorific title for Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and for other revered figures in Islamic history. The title reminds us of the Prophet's unique position as the final messenger of Allah and emphasizes his role in completing the message of previous prophets.
data.spiritual_significance: Khaatim is a name with deep spiritual significance. It is a reminder of Prophet Muhammad's (PBUH) role as the last and final messenger of Allah. In Islamic faith, Prophet Muhammad's (PBUH) teachings and messages are considered the seal of divine revelation. The name Khaatim serves as a reminder of the precious legacy of the Prophet, and of the importance of holding on to his teachings in our daily lives. It also underscores the continuity of divine guidance through the ages, which began with Adam (AS) and culminated in Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).

historical_references.context: Khaatim Al-Asadi: A famous Companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), known for his generosity and hospitality. He was a leader of the Ansar (Helpers) of Medina and a close friend of Ali ibn Abi Talib. Khaatim was one of the first people to accept Islam in Medina and supported Prophet Muhammad during the early years of Islam.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Baladhuri, Ansab Al-Ashraaf, Volume 2, Page 150 The name Khaatim carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Khaatim Al-Hilali: A prominent scholar and jurist during the Umayyad Caliphate. He was born in Kufa, Iraq, and studied under some of the most renowned scholars of his time. Khaatim was known for his rigorous adherence to the Sunnah and his staunch opposition to the Umayyad dynasty's deviations from Islamic law.
